subject: english
stem: Mia wanted to learn the song on piano. After one difficult part frustrated her, she slowed the recording and practiced only four notes. What does the smaller practice step show?
options: She wants to erase the recording.
She is still pursuing the same learning goal.
She has changed to learning drums.
She has already mastered the song.

optionRationales.reason: She wants to erase the recording.：未提。
She is still pursuing the same learning goal.：縮小步驟仍練同一歌曲。
She has changed to learning drums.：未提。
She has already mastered the song.：仍在練 difficult part。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「人物的目標由需求或意圖建立，後續行動與反應顯示是否持續或改變」可推出 She is still pursuing the same learning goal.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 She is still pursuing the same learning goal. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
